word_family.translation: to repeat an experiment and obtain the same result
the act of repeating a study to confirm its findings
able to be repeated with the same result
impossible to repeat with the same result

sentence: The team could not confirm the original findings because the experiment was not ______. (replicate)
explanation: We need an adjective meaning 'able to be repeated'. The suffix -able forms an adjective from the verb 'replicate'.
